$comment: DTM 2012 car images drawn by Pappydhorn12 (used with the artist's permission). Each source file is a square sheet of a team's cars on black, stacked top to bottom; 'cars' lists their numbers in that order (from research/entries.csv) and 'team' picks the team image (the lower-numbered car, as the game shows one car per team). tools/car_drawings.py crops them; the other car of each team is kept in art/liveries (not in the pack) for a future livery choice (wishlist E4).

Mercedes_AMG.png.note: a faint shadow line (values up to 30, 12 px below the tyres) runs under #6 at ground level and joined its tyres

Mucke_Motorsport.png.note: Wickens' stern car is drawn with number 21; the 2012 entry list (research/entries.csv) has him as #20

Persson_Motorsport.png.note: Wolff's TV Spielfilm car is drawn with number 20; the 2012 entry list has her as #24

Phoenix_Racing.png.note: faint shadow lines (values up to 15) under both cars

Team_Rosberg.png.note: faint shadow lines (values up to 38) under both cars
